findings.description: The review window for this velocity anomaly alert contained no recorded transaction activity.
findings.why_it_matters: Without activity in the review window, the underlying trigger for the velocity anomaly alert cannot be directly evaluated.

findings.description: Background context transactions nearest in time show standard amounts ranging between 1301 and 9658.
findings.why_it_matters: It establishes recent account behavior despite the absence of transactions within the specific review window.

investigation_questions: Why did the velocity anomaly alert trigger if there was no recorded transaction activity in the review window?
Are there any external or system-level factors that caused a reporting delay for the account activity?

recommended_next_steps.step: Verify source of funds for the anomalous amount or review window discrepancy.
Compare the flagged transaction or background activity to historical patterns.

report.narrative_summary: An investigation was initiated for a velocity anomaly alert on the account of Divya Pandey, a low-risk government employee. Notably, the review window itself was empty with no recorded transaction activity. Review of background transactions nearest in time showed normal activity levels. Further review using standard playbook guidelines is recommended to determine the cause of the alert.
